text: Who are the leading luxury real estate agencies and top-performing auctioneers for prestige residential properties in Melbourne?

result.keyword: Who are the leading luxury real estate agencies and top-performing auctioneers for prestige residential properties in Melbourne?

items.markdown:
Melbourne's premier prestige residential market is anchored by elite specialist agencies like [Kay & Burton](https://www.kayburton.com.au/), [Marshall White](https://www.marshallwhite.com.au/) , and [Melbourne Sotheby's Realty](https://melbournesothebysrealty.com/) , alongside REIV-recognized master auctioneers such as Paul Tzamalis, Luke Banitsiotis , and Greg Brydon who command high-end auction campaigns.

### Leading Luxury Real Estate Agencies

- **Kay & Burton:** Operating since 1938 with a core stronghold in Toorak and the Bayside/Mornington Peninsula sectors, known for discrete handling of ultra-high-net-worth local and international private wealth.[[1]](https://www.kayburton.com.au/)
- **Marshall White:** A dominant force across Stonnington, Boroondara, and Port Phillip, handling a high volume of multi-million dollar transactions and landmark family estates.[[1]](https://www.marshallwhite.com.au/)
- **Melbourne Sotheby's Realty:** Leverages a powerful global luxury network to position high-value architectural and historic properties to international buyers.[[1]](https://melbournesothebysrealty.com/)
- **RT Edgar:** A long-standing heritage brand specializing in blue-chip inner-suburban Melbourne and coastal luxury retreats.
- **Jellis Craig:** Commands significant market share across Melbourne’s inner-east and inner-north premium corridors with robust auction performance.

### Top-Performing Prestige Auctioneers

- **Paul Tzamalis:** Multi-award-winning senior auctioneer (including REIV Senior Auctioneer of the Year titles) renowned for high-stakes, high-energy luxury property call-outs.
- **Luke Banitsiotis:** Recognized REIV Master Auctioneer frequently steering competitive bidding for major prestige properties across Melbourne's inner suburbs.
- **Greg Brydon:** Inducted REIV Master Auctioneer celebrated for tactical command and poise on multi-million dollar auction floors.[[1]](https://reiv.com.au/membership/auctioneering-competitions/auction-competitions-past-winners)
